scope: Multi-maker official API pricing, context/cache/service tiers, reviewed metered API chart points, and primary-source exact releaseDate backfill across 12 makers.

documentedRemainingGaps.Xiaomi: platform.xiaomimimo.com/#/docs/pricing/pricing is a client-rendered SPA without static HTML pricing tables or llms.txt; third-party/upstream references retained rather than inventing unverified primary numbers.

documentedRemainingGaps.Alibaba_qwen3_7_plus_and_qwen3_8_flash_n: qwen3-8-flash-next doc URL returned 404; alibabacloud.com context-cache TLS connection reset prevented verbatim cache-rate verification for qwen3.7-plus in this pass.
documentedRemainingGaps.Mistral_large_4_and_cache: mistral-large-4 excluded from api-price-points pending preview vs open-weight score identity resolution; Mistral pricing table publishes '-' for cached input on mistral-small-4 and ministral-3-*.
documentedRemainingGaps.Cohere_north_mini_code: Open-weight Apache 2.0 release without published first-party serverless token table; command-a-plus retains unverified cache rate.
documentedRemainingGaps.Grok_retired_fast_slugs: grok-4-fast, grok-4.1-fast, grok-code-fast-1 retired on May 15, 2026 and auto-redirect to grok-4.3 per docs.x.ai.
